title: Section 251 BNSS — Framing of charge in sessions trial

content.heading: Framing of charge
content.text: If, after considering the record and hearing the parties, the Judge is of opinion that there is ground for presuming that the accused has committed an offence which is exclusively triable by the Court of Session, he shall frame in writing a charge against the accused. This is the successor of CrPC 228.
